caption: The drawing depicts a handheld fan composed of numerous peacock feathers. The feathers are densely arranged, fanning out from the base and filling the upper two-thirds of the image. Each feather features the characteristic “eye” of a peacock plume, containing concentric circles of blue, green, and yellow, surrounded by fine lines of brown, purple, and green hues. The feather tips are delicate, curving, and multicolored, with thin strokes in pink, yellow, green, and blue. The base of the fan has a soft, fluffy cluster of grayish-brown feathers providing volume and transition to the handle. The handle is elongated, narrow, and patterned with an oval, net-like design outlined in muted purple and gray. The background is an even, light beige color, with no other objects or details present. The artist’s signature, “Edna Rex,” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Peacock Feather Fan
